description: Springing from the hallowed halls of Valhalla, Yggdrasil is a legendary tree that serves as a bridge between the ancient worlds. As the source of all life, it is said that its roots tap into the essence of life itself, and its boughs span across every plane in every universe. Though its Herald is but an offshoot of the great tree, it still possesses a incredible amount of power—the better to weather enemies and shelter allies with.Yggdrasil itself is genderless, and so are its Heralds. This one has chosen a female form, but her unearthly beauty has been infused with a wicked grace by twisted corruption. How this came to pass is a mystery; what could have happened in Valhalla to give birth to such a creature?
summon: No longer shall I herald the essence of life.Existence will come to an end.
evolution: My power waxes where others wanein the shadow of poisons and pain.
